When kids are mean to your child… 🐑🦁 "Baby!" "Crybaby!"

Leo means lion, but at seven, he's the quiet one. Gentle as a lamb. And how you respond can change everything:
1️⃣ Stop saying "Just ignore it." He just learns to swallow the hurt.
2️⃣ Give him the words. "Stop. I don't like that."
3️⃣ Never shame him for freezing. "I'm proud of you."
4️⃣ Walking away isn't weakness. Sometimes it's the strongest move he has, and it leads him to a trusted adult.
5️⃣ He never has to handle it alone. Step in. 🤝

Three weeks later, it happens again. This time, Leo looks him in the eye and says, "Stop. I don't like that." ✋ That night his mom tells him, "That's what brave looks like." ❤️

Jesus is both the Lamb and the Lion. When people mocked Him, He was never cruel back. "When he was reviled, he did not revile in return." 1 Peter 2:23 (ESV) 🙏

You're not raising a mean kid to beat the mean ones. You're raising one who's kind, gentle and strong, who has boundaries and speaks up. 🦁

And if your child is too scared to speak up, that quiet may be worry. ❤️
